CLINICAL FEATURES OF SEIZURES/EPILEPSIES
- Classical attack with sudden loss of consciousness, jerking of limbs (tonic
and/or clonic)
- Tongue biting; sphincteric dysfunction, frothing and postictal headaches
- Some may present with aura like abnormal sensation or perception,
epigastric discomfort; hallucinations, automatisms (semi-purposive
actions); Loss of postural tone (sudden falls without convulsions)
- Limb paralysis (Todd's paralysis) usually after attacks
